dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, you used to be an actor?

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: Hehe... Indeed. You might not be able to tell looking at me now, but back in the day, I was the reigning star for quite a few years too. The bouquets showered upon me were simply countless.

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: But... as you can see, youth and beauty are but fleeting illusions.

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: The moment the singer loses her brilliant luster, all the nobles and rich men who had worshiped her so will simply vanish in an instant.

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: For what they adore is that flawless illusion on stage, and not the person behind it. This is something I know intimately, as someone who wandered and begged in the streets of Gornylo as a child.

dialogues.speaker: Dorofeya
dialogues.text: This is why I chose to make my departure at the absolute zenith of my career. Fortunately, my husband is a nobleman who, dull as he may be, has a heart that is entirely true... As you well know, noblemen like that are truly hard to find.
